name: winter wolf
desc: Winter Wolf is a CR 3 monstrosity.

actions.name: snow camouflage
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to &reference[hide] in snowy terrain.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a [[/save]] saving throw or be knocked &Reference[prone].

actions.name: cold breath
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} exhales a blast of freezing wind in a [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=4YgvBZjoO2Qd5OY3]]. Each creature in that area must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: pack tactics
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally isn't &reference[incapacitated apply=false].

actions.name: keen hearing and smell
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.
